page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance features 32 virtual CPUs, representing 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No local storage or dedicated GPUs are bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge within the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The instance achieved a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 30666.35 and a Passmark CPU score of 29517.51. Memory performance tests show a read-only cached small-block bandwidth of 1705.41 GB/sec, which drops to 109.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. In application-specific tests, the server demonstrated a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec and processed 28.91 million Redis SET operations per second.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge offers a balanced general-purpose profile with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent performance without resource contention. However, the complete absence of local storage requires reliance on external block storage, which may introduce latency tradeoffs. Given its hardware profile and benchmark results, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded application servers, medium-scale database operations, and software compilation tasks.
